newsitem.title: GERMANY: German electronic trade to reorganise bond dealing.
newsitem.headline: German electronic trade to reorganise bond dealing.

text.p: The German stock exchange said on Thursday it planned to reorganise bond market trading once its forthcoming new full electronic dealing system Xetra is introduced.

Instead of the continuous trading which currently takes place on the IBIS screen-based dealing system, Xetra will offer at least three separate auctions, Frank Gerstenschlaeger, the deputy project-leader, told reporters.
"The auction process will allow market participants to concentrate on these deadlines in order to continue trading off-bourse afterward," Gerstenschlaeger said.
IBIS-R, the current screen-based system for bond trading, represents only a small proportion of volumes, most of which are traded off-bourse.
The first stage of Xetra will begin by the end of this year, focusing on wholesale trades, and will be extended by the end of 1998 to be a full competitor for floor-based trading.
